stage1.impression: A moody idea, a red speaker throwing a narrow column of its colour up a night wall, but the frame is badly underexposed: the speaker is a murky, near-black red block smaller than the wall around it, and the only crisp thing in the picture is a hot white sliver of plinth lens. The cool wall is brighter than the product, the red streak looks like a smeared projection more than light, and the concrete reads as layered strata, not board-formed. It reads as a dark CG test, not a campaign.

blocking_9: The speaker must be the brightest coloured mass in frame: body lum_median above the surrounding wall, its tint and inner batts readable, not crushed (body crush_pct under 5)
The colour on the wall must read as a wide, soft glow rising from behind the speaker, clearly brighter and more saturated than the moonlit wall, not a thin smeared stripe
The cool moonlit wall must sit well below the product and the coloured pool in value
No hard clipped white edge on the plinth lens; the light source should glow, not cut a white line
The speaker must fill a meaningful part of the frame (about 30 to 40 percent of the height) with an eye-level, non-wide-angle perspective
The wall must read as board-formed concrete (board seams and tie holes), the paving as wet night concrete with a readable coloured reflection

defects.what: Speaker body underexposed and muddy: lum_median 6.5, 23 percent crushed, darker than the wall behind it (29)
Horn reads as a dull dark-red slab, lum_median 8.6, no light through its resin
Plinth lens front edge is a hard near-clipped white strip (p95 248), the brightest thing in frame and it pulls the eye off the product
Coloured wall light is a narrow smeared stripe (lum_median 32.7 vs wall 29), barely above the moonlit wall and patchy, reads as a projection not light
Moonlit wall is cool blue and as bright as the coloured pool, flattening the hierarchy; left half brighter than right (29 vs 22)
Wall texture reads as horizontal sedimentary layers, not board-formed concrete; no board seams or tie holes
Paving is near black and featureless (lum_median about 12), the wet reflection of the speaker is faint and muddy
Product occupies about 16 percent of frame width; 22 mm lens from 0.6 m leaves acres of empty dark wall and makes the speaker read small

changes.problem: The uplight is too weak relative to the moon, so the speaker and its colour on the wall sit at or below the cool wall in value.

evidence.measured: body lum_median 6.5, crush 23 percent; wall 50-250 x 100-400 lum_median 29; red column lum_median 32.7

changes.expected: Light through the cabinet and horn triples; the column on the wall and the horn glow clearly above the moonlit wall; body tint and batts readable.

changes.problem: Moonlight lights the wall as brightly as the speaker's colour, killing the hierarchy and pushing the frame blue.

evidence.measured: lum_median 29, b_median 41 vs r_median 18; brighter than the product body (6.5)

changes.expected: Wall away from the pool drops to a dark, barely textured blue-grey; the coloured pool and speaker become the lit subject.

changes.problem: A 22 mm lens from 2.45 m makes the speaker tiny in a frame of empty wall.

evidence.measured: speaker plus horn spans about 130 px of 800 width, about 35 percent of height including the wall above

changes.expected: Speaker occupies about a third of the frame height with the plinth in the lower third and the coloured wall rising above it to the top; flatter, eye-level perspective.

changes.problem: The plinth's emissive lens shows a hard white front edge that is the brightest thing in the frame.

evidence.measured: p95 248, range 246; edge step -39.8 over 4 px at x about 318

change.to: emit 0.35, size [0.58, 0.45] so a 2 cm black rim of set.props.2 frames it

changes.expected: The lens glows warm and soft under the speaker's foot instead of cutting a white line; no pixels near clipping there.

changes.problem: The coloured light reaches the wall as a narrow, smeary stripe instead of a soft rising glow.

evidence.measured: column about 75 px wide; profile up the column 28.6 to 50.5 then 36.5, patchy

changes.expected: A faint visible coloured volume above the horn and a wider, softer-edged pool on the wall; the transition from speaker to wall reads as light.

changes.problem: The wall texture reads as layered sediment, not board-formed concrete.

evidence.measured: seen: wavy horizontal strata, no board seams, no tie holes

change.to: a board-formed concrete scan with 150 mm board lines and tie holes, bump 0.8, vary 0.12

changes.expected: Straight horizontal board seams and grain catch the grazing uplight within the coloured pool.

changes.problem: The paving is black and dull; the product's coloured reflection barely reads.

evidence.measured: lum_median 11.9, range 6.3; under the plinth 320-440 x 720-790 lum_median 4.4

change.to: wet 0.7, puddle 0.8 with a puddle in front of the plinth

changes.expected: A soft coloured reflection of the plinth glow and speaker on the wet ground, grounding it.

changes.problem: Overall exposure is very low: 98 percent of the frame below lum 40.
changes.expected: A night image with true blacks but a full tonal range on the subject: p99 around 200 without clipping.

out_of_scope.request: More light through the cabinet's front so the woofer ring and body read brighter
